_comment: Seed labels for the Stage 2 classifier. label 0 = simple (Tier 1), 1 = complex (Tier 2). IMPORTANT: Stage 2 only ever scores prompts that already passed Stage 1, so the complex examples here deliberately avoid code fences, step markers and math operators - those are caught for free upstream and would skew training toward a distribution the classifier never sees. The trainer drops any example Stage 1 would route directly and reports how many. This set is ~150 examples, below the 200-500 the design document calls for, so treat holdout accuracy as indicative rather than settled.
